subject: Indication: 25kt propane FOB Houston Aug-15
body:
Dear team,

25kt propane FOB Houston for Aug-15 lifting, indication $610/mt vs USGC mean - 2 with quality discount. Firm by today EOD if tight. Counterparty rated A by major credit agency. Vessel TBN, owner accepts BIMCO LPG-VOY 2024.

Thanks,
Martin / Acme Energy

subject: Bid wanted — 22kt CFR Chiba Sep-01
body:
Looking for a bid: 22kt propane CFR Chiba, Sep-01 to Sep-10 narrow window. Floating price (Saudi CP - 5). Buyer is a major Japanese utility with 30-day open credit. Subject vessel approval, would expect VLGC 84+ kcbm. Validity 24h.

Best,
Desk Hellenic

body:

subject: Spot offer — 12kt cargo Antwerp Jun-22
body:
Distressed spot offer (vessel in port, must lift):

  12kt mixed C3/C4 (60/40 split) FOB Antwerp
  Window: Jun-22 to Jun-26
  Price: $565/mt fixed
  Quality: C3 95.5% min, sulphur < 50ppm

We need a firm by 14:00 GMT today or we discharge to terminal storage. CIF terms negotiable for trusted counterparty.

Thanks,
Continental

subject: URGENT: counter on USGC->FE arb
body:
Counter to your last:

50kt USGC propane FOB, Sep-01 lifting, target Chiba Sep-25. Buyer offers $640/mt CFR Chiba final, freight on their account at owner-confirmed rate of $63/mt USGC->Chiba. Net to you ~$577/mt FOB equivalent. Subject Saudi CP holding above $620/mt benchmark month.

Firm 30 minutes. Standby for confirmation.

GEB NY
